## Biography

I am a [Professor of Transport Data Science](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/transport/staff/953/dr-robin-lovelace){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} at the [University of Leeds](https://www.leeds.ac.uk/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} [Institute for Transport Studies](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/transport){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}, where I build open tools and reproducible workflows for evidence-based transport planning.

I share code, methods, and writing on [GitHub](https://github.com/robinlovelace){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} and in the [posts section](/posts/). If you would like to collaborate, feel free to [email me](mailto:r.lovelace@leeds.ac.uk).

[Current projects](/projects/){.btn .btn-primary .me-2}
[Publications](/publications/){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## Experience

- **Associate Professor** (2019 - Present)  
  [University of Leeds](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/transport/staff/953/dr-robin-lovelace){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} (Leeds, UK)  
  Teaching and researching transport data science. Lead developer of the TDS MSc module.

- **Principal Investigator** (2019 - Present)  
  [SaferActive](https://saferactive.org){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} (UK)  
  Responsibilities include project management, data analysis, and active travel safety modelling.

- **Lead Developer** (2015 - Present)  
  [Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT)](https://www.pct.bike/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} (UK)  
  Leading development of the R code, spatial model pipelines, and interactive web mapping dashboard.

- **Principal Investigator** (2017 - 2018)  
  [Cycling Infrastructure Prioritisation Tool (CyIPT)](https://cyipt.bike){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} (UK)  
  Managed project pipelines, spatial data analytics, and cycle infrastructure planning models.

## Education

- **PhD in Transport and Energy** (2013)  
  University of Sheffield (Sheffield, UK)  
  Research focused on spatial microsimulation, energy futures, and transportation analysis.

- **MSc in Environmental Science & Management** (2009)  
  University of York (York, UK)

- **BSc in Environmental Geography** (2008)  
  University of Bristol (Bristol, UK)
